explanation: All 12 gates require independently reviewed primary evidence; this tool cannot certify a system. Hardware and third-party security sign-off cannot be inferred from logs.

benchmarks.why: Boot latency, responsiveness, gaming, power comparisons measured

hardware.why: Supported hardware matrix and driver, networking/audio, suspend/resume validated

licenses.why: Full corresponding GPL Linux kernel source, notices and patch provenance audited

qemu_boot.why: Compiled kernel booted a disposable QEMU initramfs

real_kernel_packages.why: Real image + header Debian packages built and verified

rollback.why: A/B update failure and rollback tested, with rollback prevention

sandbox.why: MAC, capabilities, filesystem and process attacks independently tested

third_party_assessment.why: External security assessment completed by qualified independent reviewers

uefi_signed_boot.why: UEFI Secure Boot plus authenticated kernel/initramfs/cmdline proved

vault.why: Secure Rift real create/unlock/lock/recovery and adversarial review

velora_latest.why: Latest Velora source/hardware integration verified with rollback

verity_root.why: Kernel boots into authenticated dm-verity immutable root
